description: This is a Flutter widget source file defining a HomeScreen widget for a notes application. It includes UI layout, mock data for notes, and method stubs for search and add note actions.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main screen showing a list of notes with search and add actions.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: The private State class for HomeScreen, managing UI state and behavior including a list of mock notes.

methods.name: _onSearchPressed
methods.description: Handles tap on the search icon, currently shows a snackbar as placeholder.

methods.name: _onAddNote
methods.description: Handles tap on the add note button, currently shows a snackbar as placeholder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the HomeScreen, including app bar, list of notes, floating action button, and bottom navigation bar.
